title: Patch v0.3.3: Heroic Power tunes only its current power, and a base-only number is tuned on the base face only
notes: Heroic Power's numbers each belong to their power: Degrade, Upgrade and KY's Constant reach only the numbers of the power the card has now, and a number of another power keeps its tuning until a reroll brings that power back (R1425). Thirteen numbers only the base face prints, Life Tap's damage among them, are tuned on the base face only (R1426).
